per_item.question: How long until my money comes back after I bring something back?
per_item.answer: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after the return is received [1]. The evidence does not specify how long it takes for the money to actually appear in your account after processing.

per_item.question: Can I get my money back on clearance stuff?
per_item.answer: You cannot get your money back on clearance items marked "FINAL," as they are not eligible for return or exchange [1].

per_item.question: What happens if I lose my receipt?
per_item.answer: If you lose your receipt, you can still return items, but the return will be limited to store credit at the item's lowest selling price in the previous 60 days. Additionally, you are allowed a maximum of three receipt-less returns per customer per year [1].

per_item.question: How much did profitability on goods sold improve?
per_item.answer:
Profitability on goods sold improved as the gross margin increased to 46.5% in fiscal 2025, up from 44.9% in fiscal 2024, indicating an improvement driven by lower freight costs and a richer mix of private-label products [2]. 

The evidence does not provide specific figures on the profitability of goods sold beyond the gross margin percentage.

per_item.sql_query: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS total_revenue FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed' LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name LIMIT 201

per_item.sql_query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0), 2) AS fraction_returned FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 201
